summary: Ships a Go binary implementing a WebSocket-driven PTY agent providing remote shell access
details: This platform sub-package ships a single Go ELF binary that links gorilla/websocket and creack/pty and embeds the internal package paths github.com/ccfly/rescue/internal/{agent,setup,proto}. Embedded strings include 'ws://ccfly', 'wss://', 'https://cc.hn', and shell/package-manager references ('.zshrc', 'pacman', 'zypper'). Structurally the binary is a PTY-over-WebSocket agent: a remote endpoint drives a local shell on the host running the binary, giving the remote party full-host command execution. The tarball declares no lifecycle scripts, no main, and no bin field, so installing this sub-package alone does not auto-execute the binary; execution is driven by the companion @ccfly/setup CLI, which selects this platform sub-package via os/cpu and invokes the binary. Once invoked, the binary opens a remote-controlled shell on the Linux host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
